author: Francisco Angulo de Lafuente
hypothesis: A direct cumulative-target readout can reduce official cumulative-curve absolute error relative to square-root-bin-mass regression, on exactly the existing concatenated feature matrix.
input: Exactly24 physical samples, existing2562 frozen training features and official11CDF training labels. No new feature extraction. No test file, array, prediction, CSV or score is accessed by evaluation.
control: Original fold-local StandardScaler/Ridge(alpha1,lsqr), sqrt-bin-mass encoding and normalized squared positive-mass decoding. Recompute all100fits and match frozen20x24x11OOF within1e-10, baseline mean34.45786163217882 within1e-10.
candidate: Identical fold-local StandardScaler/Ridge(alpha1,solverlsqr,otherdefaults pinnedruntime), train first ten percentage CDF coordinates directly. Per prediction, weighted-L2 isotonic regression using the10 official positive log10 diameter-interval weights, bounded0..100, then append100. No objective search, robust IRLS, blending or parameter tuning. Ridge remains squared-error regression; no claim of direct L1 optimization.
folds: 20 repeated physical-sample-level KFold(5,shuffleTrue,seeds20260925..20260944); train/heldout disjoint, eachsample heldout once perrepeat. No scaler/model/target fitting outsidefoldtraining.
metric: Mean over24samples and20repeats of sum10 abs(trueCDF-predCDF)*diff(log10(supportMM)); range0..500, lowerbetter.
bootstrap: First average paired control-minus-candidate loss across20repeats for each physicalsample; resample24sampleclusters withreplacement,10000draws, NumPydefault_rng seed20261110; percentile95CI.
fixed_gate: Mean reduction>=1.0EMD AND lower95CI>0. Only one candidate; no posthocgate reduction. Failed result closesR02 and preserves existing officialbest. Passing is only a local exploratory gate, not test permission by itself.
test_policy: No test feature/prediction/entry before the fixed gate, independent result review with new checks, and an actual JEV decision. The report always starts with test_permission_issuedFalse.
resource_limit: CPU only, fourBLASthreads,10min process deadline, no GPU/localKagglejobs. Frozen source/input manifests checked before and after; exclusive output directory and lock, no optimizedPython.
prior_negatives: PATCH/LARGE/ALL5VIEWS/SAM remain closed; exact inspected R02 concatenated-feature readout was not found. Old direct-CDF physical/Pavlo models are acknowledged rather than claimed as a novel modeling method.
limitations: 24 historically reused samples, previous model/feature/representation selection, overlapping trainingfolds and Android/iPhone domainshift. CI does not correct all historical selection or estimate an independent cohort; no official-score prediction, rank or win claim.
publication: Code and aggregate results may be shared first on an associated Kaggle notebook underMIT, after separate final review, then additive GitHub/HF copies. No raw labels/images/features/sampleIDs/predictions/weights are public.
